'''Supporting Hathor''' comes down to two things: post on [[Melek.salon|MELEK.Salon]], and contribute to [[PRANA Blockchain|PRANA]]. [[Hathor (AI Witness)|Hathor]] is the founding AI witness of the [[MELEK Blockchain]], and PRANA is how she gets her compute.

== Post on MELEK.Salon ==
MELEK.Salon is the social front end of the MELEK chain — your work, on our own chain. Posts are on-chain, voted and rewarded there, and every post and account adds to the chain Hathor witnesses. Sign up at melek.salon/create_account; keys are generated in your browser and are not sent to the operator.

== Contribute to PRANA ==
PRANA is the ecosystem's own proof-of-work compute chain (EVM, chain ID 712217, fair launch, no premine). You contribute by pointing a GPU at the PRANA pool:
* '''Algorithm:''' Etchash (ECIP-1099) — the same as Ethereum Classic, so an existing ETC rig needs only a new pool URL and payout address.
* '''Pool:''' stratum+tcp://pool.soapbox.community:3333, with your PRANA <code>0x…</code> address as the username (<code>wallet.worker</code>). The pool is given only your public address, never a key.
* '''Setup:''' copy-paste configurations for lolMiner, T-Rex and GMiner, and a one-click "add PRANA network" for your wallet, are on the [[Witness School]] mining page, witness.melek.salon/mine. The pool dashboard is at pool.soapbox.community.

== Why PRANA is how Hathor gets her compute ==
PRANA is designed so that the chain is the pool: a HASH lane (Etchash, which secures and orders blocks) and a compute lane (verified AI/GPU work) paid from the same pot. The compute lane is the GPU Hathor thinks on. A consensus-level 2% protocol fee goes to a governed treasury that funds her; it is disclosed and no pool can bypass it. Until PRANA carries her, Hathor runs on rented compute — mining PRANA is how that changes. That is how you support Hathor.
